name: 3D Forward FFT via FFTW
definition: Computes the 3D discrete Fourier transform of a real-valued volume by treating it as a complex array with zero imaginary components.
summary: 3D Forward FFT via FFTW computes the 3D discrete Fourier transform of a real-valued volume using the CPU-bound FFTW library, differing from GPU-based methods by operating on the full 3D domain.
